objective: Qualify narrowly scoped local process-death recovery behavior with a real terminated Python subprocess using PQ-04 SQLite and PQ-05 reference-target CAS; add read-only crash reconciliation that never retries uncertain external effects automatically.
nonGoals: No true power-cut/fsync storage guarantee or NFS/fleet coordinator
No remote or authenticated service status or actual deployment
No mutation/retry of an UNKNOWN effect simply because receipt appears locally
decisions: Test actual process termination with os._exit inside isolated child; report this as process death, not host power loss.
Reopen two distinct local SQLite stores after child death to classify possible dispatch and destination records; any receipt remains reference-local and unauthenticated.

obligations.description: Observe persisted intent, reservation/possible-send and target effect after abruptly terminated child without in-memory test double
UNKNOWN and unavailable target receipt never authorize retransmission; reported contradiction fails closed
Retain remote fencing, restore anti-rollback and authenticated target limitations

impact: Read-only assessment and process-death local tests; no mutation of previous fixture outputs

budget.execution: One stable PR suite, three bounded subprocess cases, no unnecessary CI reruns

externalEffects: Local temp SQLite only; GitHub stack PR, no production or adopter effects
